summary.en: A multimodal generative system for synthesizing and editing video
summary.zh: 用于合成与编辑视频的多模态生成系统

description.en:
Runway presented Gen-2 as a multimodal system that can generate video from text, images or existing video references. Its official research page demonstrates eight modes: text to video, text plus image to video, image to video, stylization, storyboard, mask, render and customization.

The page is bylined by Anastasis Germanidis, whose personal site identifies him as a Runway co-founder and co-CEO focused on video-generation research.
description.zh:
Runway 将 Gen-2 介绍为能够依据文本、图像或现有视频参考生成视频的多模态系统。官方研究页展示八种模式：文生视频、文本加图像生成视频、图生视频、风格化、故事板、遮罩、渲染与定制。

该页面署名 Anastasis Germanidis（阿纳斯塔西斯·耶尔马尼迪斯）；其个人网站说明他是 Runway 联合创始人、联合 CEO，并专注于视频生成研究。

role.en: Company behind the Gen-2 video generation system
role.zh: Gen-2 视频生成系统开发公司

notes.en: Completed event-specific research on 2026-08-03 and expanded image and company-brand research after copyright restrictions were relaxed. The exact BenchCouncil title, order, institution, country and blank contributor/publication fields remain preserved. Anastasis Germanidis is verified as the official Gen-2 page's bylined author and as a Runway co-founder focused on video-generation research; the clear Ray Summit portrait and the multi-person Cognitive Revolution interview cover are documented but not selected because he is not an official BenchCouncil-listed contributor. Runway's Open Graph introduction image and Mode 01 text-to-video frame are documented as official product-image candidates. The official company-hosted transparent Runway wordmark is selected as the institution-identification image and is displayed unmodified on a light background before the original Gen-2 explainer, with naming, minimum-size, contrast, non-modification and terms-of-use notes retained. Gen-1 Figure 2 is documented only as technical lineage, not as a Gen-2 architecture disclosure. selectedPortrait remains null.
notes.zh: 于 2026-08-03 完成事件专项研究，并在放宽版权限制后扩展图片与公司品牌检索。BenchCouncil 的准确标题、顺序、机构、国家以及空人物/空论文字段均保持不变。现已核验 Anastasis Germanidis 是 Gen-2 官方页面署名者，也是专注视频生成研究的 Runway 联合创始人；清晰的 Ray Summit 肖像与多人构图的 Cognitive Revolution 访谈封面均已记录，但因其不是 BenchCouncil 官方列出人物而不选用。Runway 的 Open Graph 介绍图和模式 01 文生视频帧已记录为官方产品图片候选。现选用公司官方托管的透明 Runway 字标作为机构识别图，以未修改形式显示在浅色背景上，并排列在原创 Gen-2 解释图之前；名称写法、最小尺寸、明暗对比、禁止修改和条款约束说明均已保留。Gen-1 Figure 2 只作为技术脉络记录，不视为 Gen-2 架构披露。selectedPortrait 保持 null。
